elements.name: start
elements.brief: Starts the gyroscope. While started, the listener is invoked every frame
elements.description:
Starts the gyroscope. While started, the listener is invoked every frame
with the device rotation as a quaternion.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.doc: Called every frame as `(self, quatx, quaty, quatz, quatw)`.
types: (self: unknown, quatx: number, quaty: number, quatz: number, quatw: number) => void
